newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air Dolomiti adds 3rd ATR 42-500 aircraft to fleet.
newsitem.headline: Air Dolomiti adds 3rd ATR 42-500 aircraft to fleet.

text.p: Italian carrier Air Dolomiti has taken delivery of its third ATR 42-500 aircraft, European manufacturer Aero International (Regional) said.
Air Dolomiti will use the turboprop aircraft on its Genoa-Paris and Verona-Paris routes operated in code-share with Deutsche Lufthansa AG, an AI(R) statement issued here said.
The airline is the first carrier to operate the new ATR generation and will gain a fourth aircraft shortly, it added.
AI(R) said it now has delivered 495 ATR turboprops to some 81 airline clients worldwide. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
